column1: # Package ISA policy used by scripts/validate-package-isa.sh
# Format: package|policy|exception path|reason
# required: every ELF in the package must declare x86-64-v3 in GNU ISA_1_NEEDED.
# partial: same check, except for the exact bundled upstream ELF path.
# target: the PKGBUILD must explicitly pin the compiler target to x86-64-v3;
#         GNU ISA_1_NEEDED is not asserted for this toolchain/project build system.
# upstream: executable payloads are shipped prebuilt by upstream and are not rebuilt here.
# any: architecture-independent package (for example, Python scripts only).
# review: source is built locally, but this repository does not currently guarantee v3.
# r2r: .NET ReadyToRun managed code uses the x86-64-v3 instruction-set baseline; bundled native runtime components are not certified.
antigravity-cli|upstream||Upstream binary archive; not rebuilt by this repository.
